hero.title: Mogu.
hero.lede: Soft, velvety acoustic panels grown from mycelium and upcycled textile residue — nature-grown, engineered to perform. A 3D-shaped surface built to maximise absorption, brought to Denmark by Beyond Rational.

points.title: Mycelium, not foam
points.body: Panels are grown from mycelium combined with upcycled textile residue — a soft, foam-like material that reaches its final shape through biological growth, not chemical processing. Nature does the engineering.

points.title: Shaped for absorption
points.body: A velvety, three-dimensional surface, radically reshaped to absorb the frequencies of speech — tuned for offices, meeting rooms and homes alike.

points.title: Circular by design
points.body: VOC-free and 100% circular, with a screw-less fixing system for easy mounting and removal. Naturally white by default, with a wider colour range available.

gallery_head.body: Hexagons and triangles — as single tiles, as colourways, and arrayed across a wall.

cta.lede: Curious about Mogu's shapes and colour range for your project? Tell us what you're planning and we'll follow up when it's ready.
